# ARLing

> ARLing s. r. o. builds business software: browser tools and small hosted services for e-invoices (EN 16931, Peppol, XRechnung), SEPA and bank files, print approvals, supplier document renewals, website technology tracking, and an AI shopping assistant for e-shops built from the shop's product feed. Alongside that it publishes developer diagnostics, free daily logic games and a small range of digital books for e-ink tablets and print. Product pages and checkout are the source for current prices and terms.

ARLing is a one-person software company in Bratislava, Slovakia. Business software comes first: e-invoice checking and creation, SEPA payment files, bank statement conversion, payment matching, GDPR documents, ARLing Proof for print approvals, ARLing Renewals for supplier documents, ARLing Asistent (a shopping assistant for e-shops that answers from the shop's product feed and stores no conversations) and Stacklog for website technology history. Invoice validation, previews and CSV conversion run in the browser; paid exports use checkout and access verification. Proof and Renewals run on ARLing's own server in the European Union; Asistent runs on Cloudflare Workers. Publishing (puzzle books, a Catholic reading book, classics for e-ink) is a secondary line, and so is The World in Squares, a symbolic world map for fun.

Who it is for: people handling invoices, SEPA payment files or bank statements can choose a task-specific tool. Print and sign shops can run customer approvals in ARLing Proof. Market and event organisers can collect supplier documents in ARLing Renewals. E-shop owners can add ARLing Asistent from their product feed, check the feed with Product Feed Doctor and check legal basics with Kontrola e-shopu. Developers can check what a website runs on with Stacklog or debug auth, CORS, JWT and redirect problems with the free diagnostics. Readers and puzzle solvers can preview and buy digital books, families can read the free Memory Post sample (orders are paused for a few days), and publishers can license a weekly puzzle for their newsletter or buy a fixed Slitherlink pack for their own layouts. These are separate offers with their own scope.

How to use: start at https://arling.sk/ (Slovak), https://arling.sk/en/ or https://arling.sk/de/. The homepage lists the business software first and has a full directory of every tool, game and book at https://arling.sk/en/#vsetko. Browse books at https://arling.sk/shop/ and open a sample before buying. Free and paid features are identified on each product page; some services use checkout, e-mail delivery or an account. Where a line below says "including VAT", nothing is added at checkout; e-invoice prices are shown excluding VAT and Stripe adds the applicable tax at checkout.

Privacy: data handling differs by product. Many invoice and file checks run locally in the browser. Checkout, purchase access, subscriptions, contact forms, e-mail delivery, Memory Post, the hosted services and remote diagnostic lookups require server communication. Do not extend a local-only claim from one tool to the whole site; consult the individual product page and https://arling.sk/privacy/. The site counts visits with self-hosted Umami; Mail Doctor does not load analytics.

Contact: ARLing s. r. o., Ivanská cesta 19112/32E, 821 04 Bratislava, Slovakia. Company ID 56583486, VAT ID SK2122352100. E-mail support@arling.sk.

## Business software

- [ARLing Proof](https://arling.sk/proof/): print approvals with a record of who approved what. Free, capacity-limited pilot for small print and sign shops: create a workspace yourself with the "Create a free workspace" button on the page, no card and no automatic subscription; there is no price yet. Share a PNG or JPEG print preview (up to 5 MiB) with versioned production details (size, material, quantity) through a private customer link that lasts 14 days; the customer approves a specific version or requests changes, and the decision is kept with the version it belongs to. JSON export and a printable record. Owner interface in English and Slovak, customer review also in Czech and German. Runs on ARLing's own server in the European Union without external AI APIs. Not a prepress check: colour, DPI and bleed are not assessed. Slovak page https://arling.sk/proof/sk/ , German page https://arling.sk/proof/de/ , llms.txt https://arling.sk/proof/llms.txt
- [ARLing Renewals](https://arling.sk/renewals/): supplier documents and renewal dates. Free, capacity-limited pilot for market and event organisers: create a workspace yourself with the "Create a free workspace" button on the page, no card and no automatic subscription; there is no price yet. Add the documents you require, give each supplier a private upload link (PDF, JPEG or PNG up to 5 MB, no supplier account), approve or reject each version yourself, track expiry dates and see reminders inside the workspace; CSV import of up to 100 rows, CSV or JSON export. It sends no e-mail to suppliers and does not judge insurance cover, validity or authenticity. Runs on ARLing's own server in the European Union without external AI APIs. The workspace and supplier portal are in English; information pages also in Slovak https://arling.sk/renewals/sk/ and German https://arling.sk/renewals/de/ , llms.txt https://arling.sk/renewals/llms.txt
- [ARLing Asistent](https://arling.sk/asistent/): AI shopping assistant widget for e-shops, set up from a product feed (Heureka/Zboží.cz XML as exported by Shoptet or Upgates, Google Shopping, Shopify products.json, WooCommerce, generic XML). It answers only from the shop's feed and contact details, with product links, keeps no conversation content and sets no cookies; runs on Cloudflare Workers. Free up to 100 conversations a month without a card, then Starter 19 EUR a month up to 1,000 conversations or Pro 39 EUR a month up to 3,000, a monthly Stripe subscription. English https://arling.sk/asistent/en/ , German https://arling.sk/asistent/de/ . The trial form accepts ?feed=<url> to prefill the feed URL (used by Product Feed Doctor). Platform guides, the demo shop, Gift Finder and comparisons are listed under Optional.
- [Stacklog](https://arling.sk/technologies/): what a website runs on, and when it changed (Slovak: Technológie webov). Check any public domain and get the technologies that can be seen from one HTTPS request to the homepage, each finding with the exact evidence line behind it (response header, cookie name, meta tag, file path, script URL, DNS record or certificate field) and one of four confidence levels. Thirteen hygiene checks per site (HTTPS, HSTS, CSP, robots.txt, sitemap, manifest, real 404, canonical, JSON-LD, viewport, llms.txt, compression, certificate). Free without an account: 20 live checks a day, full evidence, no e-mail. Aggregate usage statistics for .sk and .cz are published only after the survey has run; until then those pages are marked as an example and carry noindex. No registrant data, no e-mail addresses, no contact lists, ever. Method and weaknesses https://arling.sk/technologies/methodology/ , crawler and opt out https://arling.sk/technologies/crawler/ , API https://arling.sk/technologies/api/ , terms https://arling.sk/technologies/terms/
- [Stacklog in Slovak (Technológie webov)](https://arling.sk/technologie/): the same service in Slovak; method https://arling.sk/technologie/metodika/ , crawler https://arling.sk/technologie/crawler/ , API https://arling.sk/technologie/api/ , terms https://arling.sk/technologie/podmienky/

## The World in Squares

- [The World in Squares](https://arling.sk/world/): a map of the whole world cut into squares of about ten kilometres, land and sea. Pick a square, give it a name, one link (https only, rel="nofollow ugc") and a 32 x 32 drawing in sixteen colours, and get a PDF certificate with the square number, its coordinates and its real size. 5 EUR once for one square through Stripe; a pack of three is 12 EUR and a pack of ten 35 EUR; a gift costs the same and prints the recipient's name on the certificate. A symbolic keepsake for fun: it gives no right, title or claim to any real land, sea, seabed or airspace, it is not an investment, not crypto or an NFT, not gambling and not an SEO service. Looking is free and needs no account. English only.
- [The World in Squares, questions](https://arling.sk/world/faq/): what exactly you buy, whether the sea or Antarctica can be bought, whether a square is really ten by ten kilometres, whether someone can overwrite a drawing and how to get the money back.
- [The World in Squares, content rules](https://arling.sk/world/rules/): what may not appear on the map, how it is moderated, how to report something and what happens after a report.
- [The World in Squares, leaderboard](https://arling.sk/world/leaderboard/): which towns and countries have the most squares; real numbers only.
- [The World in Squares, terms](https://arling.sk/world/terms/): a symbolic entertainment licence on the map with no right to any real land, sea, seabed or airspace; duration, VAT, withdrawal, moderation, refunds.
- [The World in Squares, withdrawal from the contract](https://arling.sk/world/withdrawal/): the 14 day right of withdrawal, the one case where it does not apply to digital content, and the model form.

## Invoices and payments

- [E-invoice (E-faktúra)](https://arling.sk/efaktura/): browser tool for electronic invoices under EN 16931 and Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 (UBL 2.1), with XRechnung rules for Germany. Checks an invoice XML and explains every finding in plain language with the rule code, the path to the element and the original English wording of the rule; renders the file as a readable document; and builds an e-invoice from a form for people without accounting software. In Slovakia the e-invoice becomes mandatory for VAT payers in domestic business-to-business supplies on 1 January 2027 (Act 385/2025 Coll. amending the VAT Act 222/2004 Coll., new sec. 76a; source: Financial Administration FAQ 9/DPH/2025/IM). Check and preview are free; downloading the finished XML costs 2.90 EUR for one invoice or 9.90 EUR for 30 days, excluding VAT (Stripe adds the applicable tax at checkout), one-off through Stripe. Everything runs in the visitor's browser, no file is uploaded. Czech version https://arling.sk/efaktura/cs/ ; German version https://arling.sk/efaktura/de/ ; English version for use outside Slovakia, Czechia and Germany https://arling.sk/efaktura/en/ (same engine; the English sample invoice is a cross-border reverse-charge supply with GS1 GLN electronic addresses, schemeID 0088). Landing pages that each answer one question are listed under Optional.
- [E-invoice rule code pages](https://arling.sk/efaktura/en/rules/): E-invoice rule codes explained: every rule code our e-invoice checker reports has its own static page in four languages, with what the rule checks, the original normative wording quoted with its source, the UBL element and path, a correct UBL 2.1 snippet and a link to the free checker. Indexes: https://arling.sk/efaktura/en/rules/ (English), https://arling.sk/efaktura/de/regeln/ (German), https://arling.sk/efaktura/pravidla/ (Slovak), https://arling.sk/efaktura/cs/pravidla/ (Czech). Codes covered include EN 16931 (BR-*, BR-CO-*, BR-DEC-*, BR-CL-*, VAT category rules), Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 (PEPPOL-EN16931-*, PEPPOL-COMMON-*) and XRechnung (BR-DE-*, BR-DEX-*).
- [CSV to invoice XML](https://arling.sk/efaktura/en/csv-to-invoice/): batches of up to 100 invoices and 500 lines from a documented CSV template, checked in the browser before purchase. UBL XML ZIP download with the 30-day access for 9.90 EUR excluding VAT (tax is added at checkout), no subscription. German page https://arling.sk/efaktura/de/csv-xrechnung/ ; the same batch tool is on the Slovak and Czech invoice pages. No Peppol delivery, PDF import or CII generation.
- [Changes in the Slovak e-invoicing FAQ (Zmeny FAQ k e-faktúre)](https://arling.sk/efaktura/zmeny-faq/): every 2026 version of the Slovak Financial Directorate FAQ on e-invoicing, 9/DPH/2025/IM (10 versions from 3 March to 15 September 2026, 22 to 59 pages), with the questions added, changed (word-level diff) and removed in each version and a link to the original PDF; checked daily, optional free e-mail alert on a new version (double opt-in, one-click unsubscribe).
- [SEPA pain.001 Doctor](https://arling.sk/sepa-pain001-doctor/): for Slovak banks (Tatra banka, SLSP, VÚB, ČSOB): paste a pain.001 XML payment file and get every invalid element (IBAN, BIC, amounts, NbOfTxs/CtrlSum, VS/SS/KS symbols, character set) with a fix, in Slovak. Free, client-side only.
- [SEPA pain.001 Generator](https://arling.sk/sepa-pain001-generator/): Excel or CSV list of payments to a SEPA pain.001.001.03 file, checked by the Doctor before download. Slovak, English and German UI (?lang=sk|en|de); static language pages https://arling.sk/sepa-pain001-generator/en/ (English) and https://arling.sk/sepa-pain001-generator/de/ (German, SEPA-Sammelueberweisung aus Excel); country profiles SK (VS/SS/KS symbols, Slovak bank presets) and DE (Verwendungszweck, EndToEndId, Deutsche Kreditwirtschaft rulebook). The free version has no cap on payments, files or downloads; Banking tools Pro adds saved payer profiles, column-mapping templates and several files at once. Client-side only.
- [camt.053 to Excel](https://arling.sk/camt053-to-excel/): camt.053 bank statement XML (any bank in SK, DE, AT, CH: Tatra banka, SLSP, VÚB, ČSOB, Sparkasse, Volksbank, UBS) to CSV or Excel for accountants, with references, counterparty and a balance check, CSV presets for DATEV, Lexware, sevDesk. Converting the whole statement, the totals and the balance check are free; the table on screen shows up to 200 rows; without a licence the download holds the first 20 rows with a sample header. Banking tools Pro downloads the whole file as CSV and Excel and adds MT940 and DATEV Buchungsstapel exports, several files at once and a conversion history. Slovak, English and German UI (?lang=sk|en|de); static language pages https://arling.sk/camt053-to-excel/en/ (English) and https://arling.sk/camt053-to-excel/de/ (German, camt.053 in Excel umwandeln). Client-side only.
- [camt.053 to MT940 for DATEV](https://arling.sk/camt053-to-excel/mt940/en/): converts a camt.053 statement to MT940 (.sta) or straight to a DATEV Buchungsstapel (EXTF CSV) file in the browser, for DATEV Kanzlei-Rechnungswesen, whose manual file import still expects MT940. Without a licence the page shows a preview of the first 8 lines; the download is part of Banking tools Pro. German page https://arling.sk/camt053-to-excel/mt940/ . Client-side only.
- [Payment matcher (Párovač platieb)](https://arling.sk/parovac-platieb/): matches a camt.053 bank statement (or its CSV) against an invoice list from Pohoda, Omega, Money S3, SuperFaktúra, iDoklad or Fakturoid by variable symbol, amount and date; outputs matched, partial, overdue and unmatched lists as CSV. The tables on screen are complete and free with no row limit; without a licence the downloaded file holds the first 20 rows as a sample, and the whole file is part of Banking tools Pro. Slovak UI, client-side only. English page https://arling.sk/parovac-platieb/en/ ; German page https://arling.sk/parovac-platieb/de/
- [SEPA file check (Kontrola SEPA súboru)](https://arling.sk/kontrola-suboru/): paid check of one SEPA pain.001 payment file. Order through the form on the page; ARLing replies by e-mail with instructions for sending the file securely, and within 24 hours of receiving the file sends the corrected pain.001 and a written report: what banks reject today, which addresses are not yet structured, on which line, and the exact question to send to the vendor of the accounting software. 149 EUR one-off per check, nothing is paid upfront and Stripe is not used: ARLing s. r. o. issues the invoice only after delivering the corrected file and the report, and it is paid by bank transfer; there is no invoice if the result does not arrive within 24 hours of receiving the file or the file cannot be repaired. The same engine runs free in the browser as SEPA pain.001 Doctor (https://arling.sk/sepa-pain001-doctor/); the paid check adds a manual review, the corrections and the report. The file is used only for the check and ARLing deletes it at the latest 30 days after delivery. A format check, not tax or legal advice; the bank decides whether it accepts the file. Report in Slovak; English page with the report in English https://arling.sk/kontrola-suboru/en/ ; German page with the report in German https://arling.sk/kontrola-suboru/de/
- [Banking tools Pro (Bankové nástroje)](https://arling.sk/bankove-nastroje/): one Pro licence for SEPA pain.001 Generator, camt.053 to Excel and Párovač platieb at once (SEPA pain.001 Doctor is free and needs no licence), 9 EUR a month or 79 EUR a year, VAT included, through Stripe. Every tool works free on its own: checks and conversions have no limit, the camt.053 table on screen shows up to 200 rows; without a licence the camt.053 to Excel and Párovač platieb downloads hold the first 20 rows as a sample, and MT940 and DATEV exports show an 8-line preview. Client-side only. English page https://arling.sk/bankove-nastroje/en/ ; German page https://arling.sk/bankove-nastroje/de/

## Documents and company

- [Does the e-invoice mandate apply to me? (Týka sa ma e-faktúra?)](https://arling.sk/efaktura/kviz/): a free quiz of at most six questions for Slovak businesses: VAT payer or not, who the customers are and where, how invoices are sent today. Every paragraph of the result cites the Financial Administration FAQ 9/DPH/2025/IM (version 15 September 2026) or Act 385/2025 Coll. with the page; not legal or tax advice. English https://arling.sk/efaktura/en/quiz/ .
- [EU sanctions list check (Sanktionslisten-Check)](https://arling.sk/sanktionslisten/): free, German: upload a customer or supplier list (Excel or CSV, up to 5,000 rows) and every name is compared in the browser with the EU consolidated financial sanctions list (file of the European Commission; the list date and the number of entries are shown on the page); each hit shows a score, the reason and the EU entry, results download as CSV; nothing is uploaded. Checks only the EU financial sanctions list, not OFAC, OFSI, SECO or UN lists; not legal advice; source © European Union, re-use under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU. Daily monitoring is not available yet.
- [GDPR documents (GDPR dokumenty)](https://arling.sk/gdpr-dokumenty/): Slovak GDPR document generator for a company or e-shop that runs in the browser. Free: the privacy policy (Art. 13 GDPR) and the cookie policy with the banner text. Paid: the bundle for one company, always 8 documents, with the employee notice added only when you have employees and the CCTV document only when you have cameras, so 8 to 10 documents (records of processing activities Art. 30, processor agreement Art. 28, cookie policy per Act 452/2021 Coll. sec. 109(8), consents, employee notice, internal policy, breach procedure Art. 33 and 34, data-subject request procedure Art. 15 to 22, CCTV), 39 EUR one-off including VAT through Stripe, downloaded as DOCX. Templates, not legal advice; nothing is sent to a server. Czech version with Czech law (Act 110/2019 Coll., Act 127/2005 Coll. sec. 89(3), Labour Code sec. 316) https://arling.sk/gdpr-dokumenty/cs/ ; German version with German law (DSGVO, BDSG sec. 26 and 38, TDDDG sec. 25, AO sec. 147, HGB sec. 257) https://arling.sk/gdpr-dokumenty/de/ . Pages by business type and by document are listed under Optional.
- [Contract templates (Vzory zmlúv)](https://arling.sk/vzory-zmluv/): five Slovak contract templates filled in and assembled in the browser: residential lease (Civil Code Act 40/1964 Coll. sec. 685 et seq., or short-term lease under Act 98/2014 Coll.), vehicle sale between private individuals (sec. 588 et seq. and Act 8/2009 Coll. sec. 116), power of attorney (sec. 31 et seq.), deed of gift (sec. 628 et seq., cadastre rules of Act 162/1995 Coll. sec. 42 for real estate) and notice to terminate a residential lease (sec. 710 and 711, or Act 98/2014 Coll. sec. 7). Free: full preview and DOCX download for all five templates, no account, no payment. Templates under Slovak law, not legal advice; nothing typed in is sent to a server.
- [CV builder (Tvorca životopisu)](https://arling.sk/zivotopis/): CV builder in four steps with three templates and four output languages (Slovak, Czech, German, English), downloaded as an A4 PDF; runs entirely in the browser, no account, nothing is sent. English page https://arling.sk/zivotopis/en/ ; German page https://arling.sk/zivotopis/de/
- [Product Feed Doctor](https://arling.sk/feed-doctor/): checks Google Shopping, Meta catalog CSV, Shopify products.json, WooCommerce and generic XML/CSV feeds in the browser: 31 rules (missing fields, prices, GTIN checksums, duplicates, links, availability) with fixes and a score, CSV/JSON report, nothing uploaded. English https://arling.sk/feed-doctor/en/ , German https://arling.sk/feed-doctor/de/ . Sample feed URL for the Fetch button: https://arling.sk/feed-doctor/sample-feed.xml. After an analysis the report links to ARLing Asistent with the same feed URL prefilled. Optional Feed Doctor Monitor, started from the results: our server re-checks the feed URL you give it on a schedule and e-mails you when something got worse; free for one feed with a weekly check, Pro 9 EUR a month per feed with a daily check and 90 days of score history; it stores the e-mail, the feed URL and each score, never the feed content.
- [Mail Doctor](https://arling.sk/mail-doctor/): checks a domain's public mail records (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC) in the browser and shows the findings with rule references and conditional repair suggestions; for DKIM it uses the selector from a sent message or tries a list of common names. Free, no account, no analytics. DNS questions go from the browser to public resolvers (Cloudflare, with Google as the fallback), not to an ARLing server. The checks do not predict inbox placement.
- [E-shop check (Kontrola e-shopu)](https://arling.sk/kontrola-eshopu/): free check of a Slovak e-shop address against seven legal points (withdrawal function required from 19 June 2026 under § 20a of Act 108/2024, links to the discontinued ODR platform, privacy policy link, third-party services named in the privacy policy, cookie consent tool, company ID and address, terms and complaints); reads the home page and at most three linked pages, without a browser and without AI, every row with its legal source; not legal advice.

## Developer diagnostics

- [Redirect Doctor: Expo + Supabase OAuth](https://arling.sk/expo-supabase-auth-doctor/): paste your Expo scheme, runtime, Supabase project URL, Site URL, redirect allow-list and OAuth provider redirect URIs. Get the expected redirect URL for every Expo runtime (Expo Go, dev build, standalone, web), the exact mismatches with severity, copy-paste fixes and a checklist. Free, client-side, nothing uploaded. llms.txt https://arling.sk/expo-supabase-auth-doctor/llms.txt , llms-full.txt https://arling.sk/expo-supabase-auth-doctor/llms-full.txt , GitHub https://github.com/AndryRoby/expo-supabase-auth-doctor
- [Supabase Auth Redirect Doctor for web apps](https://arling.sk/supabase-redirect-doctor/): for Next.js, Vite and SvelteKit apps where Supabase OAuth redirects to localhost or fails in production. Enter your Site URL, redirect allow-list, callback route and provider settings and get the exact mismatch and the fix. Free, client-side, nothing uploaded. llms.txt https://arling.sk/supabase-redirect-doctor/llms.txt , llms-full.txt https://arling.sk/supabase-redirect-doctor/llms-full.txt , GitHub https://github.com/AndryRoby/supabase-redirect-doctor
- [Supabase Auth Deep Link Doctor for Flutter](https://arling.sk/flutter-supabase-doctor/): for Flutter apps using supabase_flutter where signInWithOAuth or a magic link doesn't deep-link back into the app on Android or iOS. Paste your Info.plist, AndroidManifest, redirectTo and Supabase config and get the exact mismatches, severity, copy-paste fixes and a checklist. Free, client-side, nothing uploaded. llms.txt https://arling.sk/flutter-supabase-doctor/llms.txt , llms-full.txt https://arling.sk/flutter-supabase-doctor/llms-full.txt , GitHub https://github.com/AndryRoby/flutter-supabase-doctor
- [Google OAuth redirect_uri_mismatch Doctor](https://arling.sk/google-oauth-redirect-doctor/): paste the redirect URI from Google's error and your Google Cloud Console list, pick your stack (NextAuth/Auth.js, Supabase, Firebase, Passport, Django allauth, Laravel Socialite, Python google-auth-oauthlib, Expo AuthSession, Flutter, Postman, gcloud) and get the exact mismatch and the string to add.
- [Expo Universal Links and App Links Doctor](https://arling.sk/expo-universal-links-doctor/): paste apple-app-site-association, assetlinks.json and app.json values (associatedDomains, intentFilters, bundle id, team id, package name, SHA256 fingerprints) and get the mismatches and fixes.
- [Stripe Webhook Signature Doctor](https://arling.sk/stripe-webhook-doctor/): paste the Stripe error, pick your framework and body handling, and get the exact cause of signature verification failures (parsed body, wrong secret, test vs live, tolerance, proxy) with the raw-body code for your framework.
- [CORS Doctor](https://arling.sk/cors-doctor/): paste the "has been blocked by CORS policy" console error, what your front end sent, and the response headers your server sent back, and get the exact header or value that's wrong, with a copy-paste fix for 11 stacks. Client-side only.
- [JWT Doctor](https://arling.sk/jwt-doctor/): paste a JWT and see exactly why it fails (jwt malformed, invalid signature, jwt expired, algorithm confusion, issuer/audience mismatches), with signature verification via WebCrypto for HS/RS/PS/ES algorithms. Client-side only.
- [Cookie Doctor (SameSite, Secure, Domain)](https://arling.sk/cookie-samesite-doctor/): paste your Set-Cookie attributes and request context and get the exact attribute or missing fetch credentials option that's blocking the cookie. Client-side only.
- [Redirect Loop Doctor](https://arling.sk/redirect-loop-doctor/): paste your redirect chain, Cloudflare SSL mode and server/app HTTPS settings and find the exact pair of rules fighting each other behind ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS. Client-side only.
- [Firebase Auth Domain Doctor](https://arling.sk/firebase-auth-domain-doctor/): paste your firebaseConfig authDomain, page origin and Authorized domains list and get the exact cause of auth/unauthorized-domain or a signInWithRedirect that never returns. Client-side only.

## Apps

- [bookapp, a home library in millimetres](https://arling.sk/bookapp/): spatial digital twin of a home library in millimetres; free public beta for Android and Windows (English and Slovak). Downloads: https://github.com/AndryRoby/bookapp/releases/latest
- [Janii](https://arling.sk/janii/): a Windows app for wedding photographers that selects the story (about 500 of 5 000 RAW frames) and memories locally, offline, with a reason per frame. Free beta.
- [Android game support](https://arling.sk/play/support/): support for Word Search, Duel: 2 Players and Prism Night; privacy policies of the Android games are listed under Optional.

## Publishing

- [Shop](https://arling.sk/shop/): every ARLing title on one page with its price, what is in it and where else to buy it: the ten printable puzzle books, the bundle of ten e-ink puzzle books, Morning Quiet, Ben-Hur, The Count of Monte Cristo, Puzzle Post as a single issue or a subscription, Puzzle Post Bulletin for printed newsletters, a printable detective party kit for kids (The Case of the Missing Birthday Cake, https://arling.sk/shop/detective-kit/, 6.90 EUR, ages 8 to 12), and the puzzle planner on Etsy. For one-off digital purchases, follow the product page and checkout for access and download instructions. Subscriptions have their own delivery schedules and email requirements. The shop also lists Memory Post and Puzzle Studio. Prices on the shop page include VAT. The e-ink PDFs are sized 157 x 210 mm and have not been tested on physical e-ink devices, so try the free sample on your own tablet first.
- [The Case of the Missing Birthday Cake](https://arling.sk/shop/detective-kit/): a printable detective party game for children aged 8 to 12: one case, 5 suspects, 8 evidence cards, a code wheel and a logic grid with exactly one answer; 2 to 12 players, about an hour. Two PDF files of the same 15 pages (A4 and US Letter), all 15 pages shown before you buy; 6.90 EUR including VAT, one payment; nothing is shipped.
- [The Muddy Footprints: printable detective game for kids 6 to 9 &middot; ARLing](https://arling.sk/shop/detective-kit-2/): A printable detective game for children aged 6 to 9: one gentle case, 4 friends, 6 picture clues, a picture code and a detective chart with exactly one answer. 2 to 8 players, 20 to 45 minutes. A4 and US Letter PDF, 15 pages, 6.90 &euro;.
- [The Ashgrove Heron: printable mystery case file for adults &middot; ARLing](https://arling.sk/shop/mystery-case-adults/): A printable mystery case file for adults and teens 14+: a painting swapped for a copy during a power cut in 1964, six guests, 14 pieces of evidence and a logic grid with exactly one answer. 1 to 6 players, about 45 to 90 minutes. A4 and US Letter PDF, 21 pages, 9.90 &euro;.

A4 and US Letter PDF, 24 pages, 9.90 &euro;.

Bulletin Pro: three puzzles a week (easy, medium and hard) and the website of that same publication is covered too, 39 EUR a month or 390 EUR a year.
- [Memory Post](https://arling.sk/memory-post/): orders are paused for a few days while an explicit consent step for sensitive memories is added; the free sample book is available now. A gift subscription that turns one person's memories into a book. Every week one question about their life arrives by e-mail; they answer it on a page that needs no account and no password, and their own words are e-mailed straight back to them. Every month the answers so far are typeset into a hyperlinked PDF with their name on the cover, in the e-ink 157 x 210 mm page plus A4 and US Letter, with a photograph page every ten answers. 260 questions in a fixed order, available in English, Slovak, Czech, German and Polish, and the language is chosen by the buyer. When orders are open: 39 EUR a year or 4.90 EUR a month, VAT included, with a gift card the buyer prints at home.

Book 1: 31 days of Psalm and Gospel in the Douay-Rheims text, 214 pages as e-ink, A4 and US Letter PDF, 4.90 EUR including VAT through Stripe on the page, also on Etsy at the same price, free sample of days 1 to 7.

- [Puzzle Studio](https://arling.sk/puzzle-studio/): a puzzle generator that runs entirely in the visitor's browser. Eleven kinds of logic puzzle (Killer Sudoku, Nonograms, Slitherlink, Kakuro, Hashi, Masyu, Nurikabe, Star Battle, Numberlink, Anti-knight Sudoku and a logic grid), four difficulty steps, several board sizes and up to twenty puzzles in one batch. Every puzzle is generated and then handed back to the solver of its own kind, which is asked for up to two solutions; it is shown only when that solver finds exactly one without guessing, and the page prints the measured milliseconds of that check under each puzzle. Downloads: SVG, PNG at 300 dpi with the resolution written into the file, a print sheet with the solutions on the last page, and a ZIP of the whole batch. Two puzzles a day free with a credit line on the picture; Personal 4.90 EUR a month or 39 EUR a year, VAT included, removes the daily limit and makes the credit line optional; use in a publication needs a Puzzle Post Bulletin plan (from 19 EUR a month, a print licence for one publication and the weekly sheet). No account and no upload: nothing but the licence check after payment leaves the browser.

## For publishers

- [Slitherlink publisher pack](https://arling.sk/puzzle-publisher/): a fixed pack of 25 Slitherlink puzzles for print layouts, with separate puzzle and solution SVGs, PDF sheets, PNGs, JSON and a manifest; three items can be inspected free. 19 EUR including VAT, one payment through Stripe, with a non-exclusive commercial licence for your own books, magazines, newspapers, newsletters and educational materials with unlimited printed copies (the same pack may also be sold to other publishers); the ZIP downloads after payment.
- [Puzzle API](https://arling.sk/api/): 6000 logic puzzles in ten kinds as static JSON and SVG files and as an embeddable widget, each checked by our own solver for exactly one solution; no key, no sign-up, no account. Free for anything you do not sell, with the credit line "Puzzle by ARLing, arling.sk". Use in something sold (a paid newsletter or magazine, or a site that earns from ads) needs the commercial licence that comes with Puzzle Post Bulletin Pro (39 EUR a month or 390 EUR a year) for one publication, in print and on its website. Neither licence covers selling the puzzles on their own or in a puzzle book or puzzle app.

## Games

- [Films drawn in code](https://arling.sk/play/prism5/film/): short films for our games and printables, drawn frame by frame on a canvas and scored in code in the browser (no video file, no stock footage, no recording). Prism 5 (14 s, daily 5x5 gem puzzle for Android, coming soon to Google Play), [Word Search](https://arling.sk/play/word-search/film/) (20 s, calm word game for Android, coming soon), [Hedgehogs](https://arling.sk/games/hedgehogs/film/) (19 s, one real deduction on a real daily garden) and [The Missing Birthday Cake](https://arling.sk/shop/detective-kit/film/) (20 s, printable detective party game for kids, 6.90 EUR).
- [Games](https://arling.sk/games/): fourteen daily logic games in the browser; every puzzle is generated for its date, checked by the program to have exactly one solution and played without an account or ads. Ten games went live on 10 September 2026, Dormice on 17 September 2026 and Owls, Beavers and Foxes on 26 September 2026; each archive also holds earlier days back to 10 September 2025, made by the same program. The guide, practice sets and archive of each game are listed under Optional.
- [Hedgehogs](https://arling.sk/games/hedgehogs/): daily logic puzzle, two hedgehogs in every row, column and flowerbed, no two may touch; generated with exactly one solution, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (8x8), Wednesday and Thursday medium (9x9), Friday and Saturday hard (10x10), Sunday challenge. Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.
- [Magpies](https://arling.sk/games/magpies/): daily picture logic puzzle (nonogram), fill the grid following the numbers by every row and column to reveal the picture; generated with exactly one solution, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (8x8), Wednesday and Thursday medium (10x10), Friday and Saturday hard (12x12), Sunday challenge (15x15). Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.
- [Otters](https://arling.sk/games/otters/): daily loop logic puzzle, draw the otters' river as one closed loop along the grid lines, a number in a patch says how many of its sides the river runs along; generated with exactly one solution, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (5x5), Wednesday and Thursday medium (6x6), Friday hard (7x7), Saturday tough (8x8), Sunday challenge (9x9). Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.
- [Cranes](https://arling.sk/games/cranes/): daily logic puzzle, cranes rest on sandbanks and you join them with straight walkways so that every sandbank has as many walkways as its number, at most two between the same pair, no crossings, and every sandbank reachable from every other; generated with exactly one solution, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (7x7), Wednesday and Thursday medium (9x9), Friday and Saturday hard (11x11), Sunday challenge (13x13). Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.
- [Swans](https://arling.sk/games/swans/): daily loop logic puzzle, swans rest on a lake and you draw one closed loop through every one of them; at a white swan the loop goes straight and turns just before or after, at a black swan it turns and goes straight on both sides; generated with exactly one solution, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (6x6), Wednesday and Thursday medium (7x7), Friday and Saturday hard (8x8), Sunday challenge (10x10). Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.
- [Voles](https://arling.sk/games/voles/): daily shading logic puzzle, the meadow is flooding and every number is a vole family that says how big their island is; shade the water so every island has exactly one number, islands never touch by a side, all the water connects and no two by two block is all water; generated with exactly one solution, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (6x6), Wednesday and Thursday medium (8x8), Friday and Saturday hard (10x10), Sunday challenge (12x12). Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.
- [Squirrels](https://arling.sk/games/squirrels/): daily cross sum logic puzzle, squirrels hide acorns in the hollows of a wood and each sign says how many acorns are in the run of hollows to its right or below it, every hollow holds 1 to 9 and no number repeats within a run; generated with exactly one solution, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (6x6), Wednesday and Thursday medium (8x8), Friday and Saturday hard (10x10), Sunday challenge (12x12). Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.
- [Herons](https://arling.sk/games/herons/): daily path logic puzzle, each pair of numbered nests belongs to one pair of herons and you draw a flight path between the two nests of every pair, through neighbouring cells, never crossing, until every cell of the marsh is used by exactly one path; generated with exactly one solution, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (5x5), Wednesday and Thursday medium (6x6), Friday and Saturday hard (7x7), Sunday challenge (8x8). Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.
- [Badgers](https://arling.sk/games/badgers/): daily sum cage logic puzzle (killer sudoku style), fill a 9x9 grid (6x6 on Monday and Tuesday) so that every row, column and block has each number once, the dotted cages show the total of the numbers inside and no number repeats inside a cage; nothing is given at the start; generated with exactly one solution and solvable without guessing, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (6x6), Wednesday and Thursday medium (9x9), Friday and Saturday hard, Sunday challenge. Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.
- [Hares](https://arling.sk/games/hares/): daily sudoku variant with a chess knight rule, fill a 9x9 grid (6x6 on Monday and Tuesday) so that every row, column and block has each number once and two cells a knight's move apart never hold the same number; from Friday to Sunday an anti-king rule is added (no equal numbers in touching cells, corners included); generated with exactly one solution and solvable without guessing, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (6x6), Wednesday and Thursday medium (9x9), Friday and Saturday hard (knight and king), Sunday challenge. Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.
- [Dormice](https://arling.sk/games/dormice/): daily logic grid puzzle (deduction from numbered clues), match every dormouse to a store, a tree and a week; generated with exactly one solution and solvable without guessing (the hardest days ask you to test one assumption), runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (three categories of five, no weeks), Wednesday and Thursday medium (four categories of four, with the weeks), Friday and Saturday hard (the same shape), Sunday challenge. Auto cross fills implied crosses; hints explain the next step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.
- [Owls](https://arling.sk/games/owls/): daily binary logic puzzle, fill every branch of the tree with a day owl or a night owl so that each row and column has as many of one as of the other, no three alike sit side by side and no two rows or columns are alike; generated with exactly one solution, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (6x6), Wednesday and Thursday medium (8x8), Friday and Saturday hard (10x10), Sunday challenge (12x12). Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.
- [Beavers](https://arling.sk/games/beavers/): daily trees and tents style logic puzzle, give every tree its own beaver lodge next to it, lodges never touch, not even diagonally, and the numbers by every row and column say how many lodges it holds; generated with exactly one solution, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (8x8), Wednesday and Thursday medium (10x10), Friday and Saturday hard (12x12), Sunday challenge (14x14). Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.
- [Foxes](https://arling.sk/games/foxes/): daily placement logic puzzle, a family of foxes shares one lair, something has gone missing and the numbered clues leave exactly one way to place every fox; the fox left alone with the lost thing has it; generated with exactly one solution, solvable by reasoning alone, runs in the browser. Difficulty follows the week: Monday and Tuesday easy (5x5, four foxes), Wednesday and Thursday medium (6x6, five foxes), Friday and Saturday hard (7x7, six foxes), Sunday challenge (7x7). Hints explain the next logical step; Check reports mistakes first as a count, then shows them.
- [Field Notes](https://arling.sk/games/field-notes/): a free word search in a naturalist's notebook, in the browser. Each page is one of nine themes (The Solar System, Trees of the Forest, Birds of Europe, Musical Instruments, Ocean Life, Great Inventions, Mountains of the World, Garden Vegetables, Minerals and Gems); every word you find is inked in and painted in watercolour, drawn in code, with one short fact and its source (Wikipedia). A page of the day, the same for everyone, and endless pages; hints in two steps, no timer, no ads, no account; the finished page can be saved as a poster (SVG, A4).
- [Field Notes printable word searches](https://arling.sk/games/field-notes/printable/): free printable word searches with pictures in nine subjects (ocean animals, solar system, musical instruments, vegetables, birds, trees, mountains, inventions, minerals and gems); each is two pages, the 12 by 12 puzzle with drawings to colour and the answers with one sourced fact per word, as A4 and US Letter PDF, no account.
- [Grandpa's Lighthouse](https://arling.sk/games/escape/lighthouse/): a free escape room in the browser: one lighthouse keeper's room and six small locks, each a little logic puzzle with exactly one answer (a picture grid, signal flags, a cipher, counting, a pebble board and a sum plate); hints in two steps, progress saved, no time limit; made for families.
